Hi folks, I am giving a talk at the Topos Institute Colloquium this Thursday ( 2024-08-22T10:00:00-07:00) called: "How to Make Mathematicians Into Programmers (And Vice Versa)". It will primarily focus on Lean, with the question: how can we apply theories/method from psychology/HCI to improve how people learn and use Lean (or tools like it)? The goal of the talk is not to regale you with an endless stream of research results, but rather to get you thinking about the possibilities of human-centered design for formalized mathematics. Abstract and stream link are here: https://researchseminars.org/talk/ToposInstituteColloquium/131/

Hope to see you there!

The talk recording is now available here: https://www.youtube.com/live/ZOT5jQ8W2Nc

Thanks to everyone who showed up! I enjoyed the rousing discussion at the end.
